decisions.reason: Directing ebook metadata to a gated viewer does not change referral-ticket recording, NFT association, or dashboard visibility.
The ebook metadata destination does not affect the public countdown for the next prize draw.
The metadata-to-viewer decision does not change dashboard visibility of referral commissions.
The source decision changes the ebook metadata destination but does not necessarily revise any current FAQ content.
The About page copy remains valid without describing the NFT metadata link destination.
The necessary NFT-metadata viewer entry point is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY.
The ebook metadata link destination does not alter the landing-page hero layout.
The accepted gated-viewer ownership mechanism is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY.
The metadata-to-viewer routing decision does not change landing-page hero copy.
The ebook metadata destination is unrelated to landing-page referral and prize copy.
Routing NFT metadata to the gated ebook viewer does not change landing-page book-cover placement or visibility.
Preventing NFT metadata from pointing directly to the PDF does not remove or change the separately requested optional email-certificate download link.
